   - The probability that a chord does not intersect the triangle is the sum of the squares of the arc lengths divided by the circumference squared.

   - Given the intersection probability is \( \frac{14}{25} \), the non-intersection probability is \( 1 - \frac{14}{25} = \frac{11}{25} \).
